bug_semantics: LocalFolderExtractor forms a filesystem path from an attacker-controlled RAR entry name and, before the direct fix, accepts it when its canonical-path string starts with the destination canonical-path string. This is not a path-component containment test: for destination /tmp/extract, ../extract_evil/pwned.txt canonicalizes under the sibling /tmp/extract_evil yet still has the lexical prefix /tmp/extract, allowing FileOutputStream to write attacker-controlled archive content outside the extraction directory. The same boundary defect affects directory entries.
flaw_origin: The exact sibling-path write was already possible before the public Git history. The sole root 6f32323c983015d96c64084418793853f514b519 is an aggregate commit titled 'initial import'; its ExtractArchive.java already passes the archive-derived name to new File(destination, name), returns that path without containment validation, and opens FileOutputStream on it. Later commits 75cb6a58c9b3ca08db954eec241b91a5331dd632 and 3b645d991563dd8933f6efab135cd76a43a92d6b copied/moved the extraction implementation. Commit e60b915f8932c08b9b6874a97f00676decba069a added a defective canonical-string prefix guard, but its direct parent remained exploitable by the advisory's same ../extract_evil path, so e60b915 is an incomplete mitigation rather than the vulnerability introducer.
ai_marker: unavailable: the true smallest BIC and its commit object predate the public repository. git cat-file commit 6f32323c983015d96c64084418793853f514b519 shows Edmund Wagner as author/committer, the message 'initial import', and no trailers, but that aggregate boundary import is not the BIC. git cat-file commit e60b915f8932c08b9b6874a97f00676decba069a likewise has a normal lucass identity and no AI trailer, but e60b915 is a rejected partial mitigation and its marker absence cannot establish NOT_AI for the unavailable BIC.
evidence: The assigned GHSA-hf5p-q87m-crj7/CVE-2026-41245 advisory identifies the /tmp/extract versus ../extract_evil sibling-prefix bypass, affects com.github.junrar:junrar <7.5.10, names 7.5.10 as first patched, and references d77e9a83eb721cd51f9c23d7869d0e6ad7f952d7. git show d77e9a83eb721cd51f9c23d7869d0e6ad7f952d7 shows the direct two-site fix from startsWith(destinationCanonicalPath) to startsWith(destinationCanonicalPath + File.separator), plus a sibling-prefix regression test/archive; its sole parent is a60857b35c17dbd5354a37816421d7b051a8ba03. git rev-parse resolves v7.5.9 to 7e1b5581f9d622b96e9e2a8574188027e7642634 and v7.5.10 to e36ee091ad7311a021e1c928ada103a3eab2d890; git merge-base --is-ancestor reports the fix absent from v7.5.9 and present in v7.5.10, while git tag --contains begins with v7.5.10. For the introducer disagreement, git show f3097eb950c9531b0013a9657469d1b102ea72e4:src/main/java/com/github/junrar/LocalFolderExtractor.java shows the direct parent of e60b915 already creating new File(destination, attackerName) and sending it to FileOutputStream with no containment guard, so the advisory's ../extract_evil exploit predates e60b915. git show e60b915f8932c08b9b6874a97f00676decba069a shows it adds the incomplete startsWith guard; git rev-list --parents -n 1 confirms parent f3097eb950c9531b0013a9657469d1b102ea72e4. git log --all --reverse -S'new File(destination, name)' reaches sole root 6f32323c983015d96c64084418793853f514b519, and git rev-list --max-parents=0 --all confirms that is the only parentless root. The root file already contains the unchecked archive-name-to-FileOutputStream path, while its commit object says 'initial import'. The same -S history and commit stats identify later implementation transfers 75cb6a58c9b3ca08db954eec241b91a5331dd632 and 3b645d991563dd8933f6efab135cd76a43a92d6b, which are rejected as copies/moves rather than BICs.
reasoning: The primary and reviewer disagreed on verdict, introducer SHA, introducer parent, parent absence, and marker state. The primary's BLOCKED/null-introducer conclusion wins; the reviewer's NOT_AI/e60b915 conclusion is wrong because it defines the flaw too narrowly as the presence of a defective guard. The vulnerability is the externally observable sibling-directory write, and the direct parent f3097eb950c9531b0013a9657469d1b102ea72e4 permits that exact write without any guard. A commit whose removal leaves the same exploit intact is not the smallest causal BIC; e60b915 merely reduced unrestricted traversal to a residual sibling-prefix bypass. The public root already contains the vulnerable sink but is explicitly an aggregate initial import, and later copies/moves are also excluded by protocol, so substituting any of those objects would fabricate a BIC. Accordingly introducer_sha and introducer_parent are null, and introducer_parent_absent is false because no true BIC parent tree exists to prove absence; the root's lack of a parent is only the repository boundary, not a verified BIC parent comparison. AI attribution must use the true BIC object, so the unavailable pre-import object yields an unavailable marker rather than treating e60b915's ordinary 2019 object as negative AI evidence. The direct fix and 7.5.10 boundary are independently verified, leaving only the pre-import origin boundary and supporting a gate-complete BLOCKED verdict.
remaining_gap: Public history does not contain the original source-control commit that first wrote the unchecked archive-entry-name-to-output-file mechanism, its immediate parent tree, or that true BIC's author/committer/message/trailers. The sole reachable boundary is an aggregate parentless initial import, so the smallest BIC, parent-absence comparison, and BIC-object AI attribution cannot be recovered from this repository.
